dogfood_validation_evidence.routing_basis: reconciliation-log-r1.md §Deferral 2 explicitly routed dogfood validation evidence to the deliverable packager for run-summary recording.
dogfood_validation_evidence.claim_verbatim: The architecture audit caught exactly the defect classes R2a's mechanisms (FR-1 design-realization audit; FR-6 agent-roster impact matrix; FR-7 skill-coverage decisions; FR-10 audit-rule discipline) are designed to prevent. Strong dogfood validation evidence for the feature's central thesis.
supporting_observations: I-AA-001 / I-AA-002 (cycle 0): the audit caught ADR-0064 and ADR-0065 contract-precision defects in the very ADRs that codify the FR-6 / FR-7 contracts — the audit machinery exercised the contracts it was being asked to ratify.

I-AA-003 (bridge-consumer count 20→24 correction): exactly the design-realization-audit defect class FR-1 targets; the bridge content prescription was inconsistent with its declared consumer count, and the audit caught it.

I-AA-004 (Skill-Coverage Decisions back-fill): the missing artifact that ADR-0065 (the FR-7 codification) requires was itself missing from R2a's first-pass output; the FR-7-discipline audit caught its absence in the run authoring FR-7. Pure dogfood evidence.
I-AA-006 (codebase-analysis inconsistency): FR-1-class divergence between an artifact's content and a downstream-cited fact, surfaced and patched in-cycle.
dogfood_validation_evidence.synthesis: R2a's reconciliation cycle 1 demonstrated four independent occurrences of the audit machinery catching defects belonging to the exact defect classes the R2a mechanisms were designed to prevent. This is strong evidence that (a) the audit dimensions FR-1/FR-6/FR-7/FR-10 prescribe are well-targeted, and (b) the discipline they impose is necessary even on the run that authors them. Recorded here per the reconciliation-log's deferral routing for Gate 6 surfacing.
dogfood_validation_evidence.implication_for_followup: R2b inherits a feature whose central thesis has been exercised against its own producing pipeline and converged — strengthening the case that the gate/validator hardening half (R2b) is the natural completion arc rather than an over-engineering risk.
